**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (satisfied by absence).**

The Agreement contains no auto-renewal mechanic. Section 2 (p0011) sets a single evergreen term running "until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6," and Section 6(a) (p0032) gives either party a 15-day for-any-reason exit when no Statement of Work is outstanding. With no automatic renewal, there is no renewal term length, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-uplift provision — so each conditional preferred/fallback element is met by absence and no redline was proposed.

One item noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged under this rule: Section 3 (p0014) permits Contractor to "change rates with 30 days notice to Company." That is an uncapped mid-term pricing right, which sits under the pricing rule rather than renewal uplift, and flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
